phantom_stampede.name: Pouncing Pack
phantom_stampede.desc: Wolves leap onto an enemy, pin it down and maul it.

howling_legion.name: Howling Legion
howling_legion.desc: A huge, lasting pack. Their howl boosts your move speed.

dire_alpha.name: Dire Alpha
dire_alpha.desc: One giant alpha wolf with cleaving bites and heavy bleeding.

murder_storm.name: Murder Storm
murder_storm.desc: A vast flock that swirls around you and sends enemies fleeing.

dive_bombers.name: Dive Bombers
dive_bombers.desc: Ravens dive at the toughest enemy nearby for huge hits.

spirit_tempest.name: Spirit Tempest
spirit_tempest.desc: Rapid bursts of eight homing bolts that explode on their last hit.

soul_lance.name: Soul Lance
soul_lance.desc: One massive bolt that pierces everything in its path.

thunder_judgment.name: Thunder Judgment
thunder_judgment.desc: Periodically strikes every enemy around you. Chains almost without limit.

static_storm.name: Static Storm
static_storm.desc: A constant lightning field strikes random enemies near you.

sanctum_halo.name: Sanctum Halo
sanctum_halo.desc: A wide ring of orbs that leaves scorched holy ground behind.

judgement_wheel.name: Judgement Wheel
judgement_wheel.desc: Fast orbs that explode on contact, then re-form.
